meta.title: Two Umbrellas and a Diving Poster

paragraphs: On Saturday afternoon, Tom and Lily went to a shop near the town pool. Mom wanted a bottle of coconut milk for the dinner. Lily also wanted a new umbrella, because she broke her old one two days ago. A shop assistant stood next to a shelf of umbrellas. "Excuse me, what is the price of this umbrella?" asked Lily. "It costs one hundred and twenty baht," said the assistant.

"Is it expensive?" asked Tom. "Not today," said the assistant. "There is a discount: two umbrellas cost two hundred baht." "That is cheap!" said Lily. "Tom, your umbrella is old, too." "It is," said Tom. "I bought it a year ago, and it has a hole." "Then we will take two," said Lily, and she took a blue one and a green one.

"Now we need the ingredient for Mom," said Tom. "Where is the coconut milk, please?" he asked. "It is on the shelf at the back, next to the rice," said the assistant. "A bottle costs thirty-five baht." Lily took one bottle from the shelf. "So the umbrellas cost two hundred baht, and the coconut milk costs thirty-five baht," said Tom. "The total is two hundred and thirty-five baht."

On the door of the shop, there was a poster about diving lessons. "Do you know about these lessons?" asked Tom. "Yes, they are at the town pool every Sunday," said the assistant. "They begin at nine o'clock and finish at half past ten." "Four lessons cost three hundred baht." "That is a good price," said Tom. "I will ask Mom and Dad." "Would you like a card with the telephone number?" asked the assistant. "Yes, please," said Tom.

Tom gave the assistant five hundred baht. "Your change is two hundred and sixty-five baht," she said. Lily gave the green umbrella to Tom and kept the blue one. At home, Mom took the coconut milk and smiled. "You bought everything, and the change is right," she said. Tom put the diving card on the table. "Mom, can I learn diving?" he asked. "We will discuss it at dinner," said Mom.
